entities.title: LodeStar
entities.summary: A desktop space trading and combat game: its rules in Rust, its picture in Godot 4.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Rust workspace (the lodestar-core crate in src/, and the infrastructure, bridge and GDExtension crates beside it), the Godot project that presents it, the clean-room design documents in docs/, the ship assets and the workspace tests. It is built with cargo and run or exported by Godot; there is no server and no web build.
boundaries: The rules come only from docs/RULES.md and the knowledge documents beside the code; the private baseline the spec was written from is never read or copied here.
Its feature, use-case and component Markdown documents are the primary record of what is built (knowledge-driven development); these .dev files describe folders and link to them.
It is not an npm project, so the repository's game workflow (.github/scripts/changed-games.sh lists only games with a package.json) neither tests nor deploys it.
